messages:
maya: Hey team — starting onboarding for `vulcan-7b` into the catalog. Can someone run a quick smoke perf and sanity check? weights are at s3://redwood-models/vulcan-7b/v1/weights.pt and tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/vulcan-7b/v1/tokenizer.json

josh: I can do a quick run. Which config should I use for batch sizing / kv cache?

maya: Start with: batch_sizes [1,4,8], seq_len 128, greedy sampling, fp16. Use the usual ri-bench harness: `ri-bench --model-path <s3> --batch 1,4,8 --seq 128 --dtype fp16 --warmup 20 --iters 200`

rachel: quick heads-up — tokenizer has a quirk: it omits explicit BOS token. If you feed it raw text we see off-by-one in prefix caching. Add `tokenizer.add_bos=True` in config or pad inputs. Otherwise KV offsets mismatch and perf looks worse.

josh: noted. running with add_bos. kicking off now (small infra hiccup earlier so may be +2m).

infra-bot: deploy-hook: started benchmark job job-id=bench-1759-02 on runner=gpu-clus-4

tom: FYI when you run, set `max_seq_cached=2048` in the runtime config — model uses rotary with longer kv and defaults were low. Otherwise we see repeated tripping of path that disables cache.

josh: first smoke results (batch=1): p50=18ms p95=42ms p99=120ms tokens/sec=450. with batch=4: p50=22ms p95=65ms p99=200ms tokens/sec=1600. batch=8 started failing OOM at our fp16 memory config. Log excerpt: ```RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB```

li: can you paste the exact runtime config you used? curious about `kv_cache_shards` and `max_seq_cached`.

josh: config snippet: ```{"dtype":"fp16","batch_sizes":[1,4,8],"seq_len":128,"kv_cache_shards":1,"max_seq_cached":1024}``` I will retry with max_seq_cached=2048 and kv_cache_shards=2 to avoid the fallback.

sofia: also check tokenizer chunking — if inputs are already tokenized with our older tokenizer, token counts differ by ~2-3 tokens which changes batching fit. May want to normalize tokenizer to v1.2 (the one in s3).

josh: rerun with updated config. batch=1 unchanged. batch=4 improved p95 -> 58ms, p99 -> 150ms, tokens/sec ~1680. batch=8 still OOM on single GPU. With kv_cache_shards=2 we can fit batch=8 on 2-GPU shard test: batch=8 p50=45ms p95=110ms p99=260ms combined tokens/sec=3100 (multi-GPU).

maya: perfect — this is actionable. Notes to add to model entry: weights s3 path, tokenizer requires add_bos=True, recommended runtime: fp16, max_seq_cached=2048, prefer kv_cache_shards>=2 for batch >=8; multi-GPU recommended for high throughput. Also add sample ri-bench command and the smoke numbers you posted.

rachel: validation check: config linter currently flags `max_seq_cached > seq_len` as suspicious. We should update linter to allow > seq_len for models with long rotary cache. Filing a tiny PR.

josh: filed bench artifact at gs://redwood-bench-artifacts/1759123456/vulcan7b/ with raw logs and profile (profile.html). Link: https://console.storage/gs/1759123456/vulcan7b/profile.html

maya: thanks — I'll update the catalog entry and add a note in the onboarding checklist about tokenizer/version mismatch. If reviewers want, please add the small linter PR and I'll merge. :thumbsup:

tom: quick follow-up — can we add a perf regression test that runs batch=4 p95 under 80ms on dedicated infra? if yes we can gate model promoted to produced catalog.

sofia: agree. I can add a CI job that runs the smoke harness weekly and alerts on p95 regressions.

maya: awesome. closing loop here — will ping when catalog page is updated. Thanks everyone.
